messages:
maya: Quick design sync on the private setup wizard network step. Sharing a lightweight figma preview: https://figma.com/file/def456 (colors will change). Main topics: Beginner vs Advanced modes, how we phrase failure states, and whether to include one-click remediation suggestions.
aj: Agree we need to make the scan approachable. Suggest headline 'Helpful checks' instead of 'Prerequisites' to reduce anxiety for non-network folks.
samir: Also recommend an expandable compact timeline for probes: rows for SSH / HTTPS / DNS with pass / warn / fail and a small 'why' disclosure to fetch details.
elaine: Accessibility: status updates should use aria-live="polite". Each probe must include descriptive text (not only an icon). When a details panel opens, trap keyboard focus inside until dismissed.
maya: Design thought: keep 'Advanced network details' collapsed by default. Failed probes get a 'Show me help' link that opens step-by-step remediation. For severity badges let's use labels Info / Caution / Failure with text + color (don't rely on color alone).
aj: Copy proposals: change 'Retry probes' -> 'Re-run checks'; 'Open firewall?' -> 'Open required ports'; and 'Dismiss' -> 'Dismiss suggestion' to avoid ambiguity.
samir: We'll need to decide what raw output appears in Advanced: short logs, commands, and a clear timestamp. Example sanitized log: ```ERR: outbound_connect 10.0.0.1:443 timeout after 5s
PROBE: curl https://metadata.redwood.local -> HTTP 200
DNS: lookup private-domain -> NXDOMAIN```
elaine: For screen-reader users, failure CTAs should include the concise reason text, e.g. 'TLS handshake failed: untrusted cert' so SR users get immediate context rather than only 'fail'.
ux-bot: Product note: Beginner mode hides raw logs and surfaces 1-click remediation suggestions like 'Add SSH egress rule' which open a guided helper. Advanced mode exposes logs, copyable commands, and more granular timestamps.
maya: Engineering question: can we surface suggested iptables/ufw commands in the advanced pane as copy-only snippets? @samir
samir: @maya We can include copy-only commands but they must be flagged as potentially risky. We should never auto-run admin commands. Also add a small confirmation banner: 'Commands are suggestions; run at your own risk'.
aj: Layout nit: status badge on left, probe name centered, CTA on right for scannability. Tighten vertical spacing so long probe lists are denser.
maya: I'll update the figma with two variants (Beginner-first and Advanced-first) and run a 6-person usability lab next Wed to test phrasing and the beginner flow. Any blockers?
elaine: No blockers. I'll draft the ARIA snippets and a11y testing checklist and share by Friday.
samir: I'll work with runtime to ensure probe payloads include short reason fields and a safe copy-only command list.
aj: :thumbsup:
